summary: Form 80, “Personal particulars for assessment including character assessment”, is the Department of Home Affairs form that collects your full personal history so it can check your identity and character for a visa. You fill it in, in English, when the office processing your application asks for it and you are 16 or older.

fields.label: Please provide your details as they appear in your official documents. / Family name / All given names
Sex: Male / Female / Indeterminate / Intersex / Unspecified / Date of birth (Day, month and year MUST be provided)
Suburb of birth / Town/City of birth / State/Province/Region / Country

Are you of Russian descent? / In English, provide your patronymic name
Have you been known by any other name(s)?
Have you ever had a different date of birth to the one shown at Question 1?
Do you currently have citizenship from any country? / No, I am stateless / How did you gain this citizenship (eg. birth, descent, naturalisation)? / Date you gained this citizenship
Do you hold or have you held citizenship from any other country (including dual citizenships and all previous citizenships)?
Do you currently have permanent residency rights in any country other than those declared in Questions 6 or 7?
